pages.transcription:
The Wyndham Hotel 42 West 58 Street
6. May
Dear Hannah, I enclose the
power of attorney for you
legalised by the British
consulate; today we are
very busy and can write no
more than that Eva is in
excellent spirits, Lotte went
to see her last Sunday. We
are happy the ~~little~~ child feels
so perfectly well amidst
of the other children (of course
you must not say to her that
she is a child - she feels
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Briefpapier des Wyndham Hotels. Die Tinte ist violett.
